title: Project BLUEBIRD authorization and research plan
summary: Agency planning documents outline proposed investigations of interrogation, polygraph, drugs and hypnosis.
outcome_or_limit: Proposal documented; specific efficacy not established
research_notes: Plans are not proof that every proposed intervention occurred.

title: BLUEBIRD interrogations of Korean prisoners
summary: Records and reporting describe interrogation research involving Korean prisoners of war; the extent of individual procedures varies across sources.
outcome_or_limit: No generalized behavioral-control efficacy demonstrated
research_notes: Details require checking underlying primary documents individually.

title: Project ARTICHOKE interrogation case
summary: An agency account describes use of chemical agents and hypnosis in an interrogation and claims successful amnesia.
outcome_or_limit: Agency claimed success; independently unverified
research_notes: A government claim of successful amnesia is not independent replication.

title: CIA–foreign intelligence meeting on mind-control research
summary: A meeting record shows intelligence agencies discussing psychological influence and individual mind-control research.
outcome_or_limit: Interest documented; operational efficacy not proven
research_notes: Distinguish discussion of goals from achieved technology.

title: Frank Olson unwitting LSD exposure
people_or_groups: Frank Olson; CIA Technical Services Staff
summary: Olson was secretly given LSD during a CIA–Army gathering shortly before his death.
outcome_or_limit: Exposure documented; causal interpretation of later events uncertain
research_notes: Do not conflate dosing evidence with disputed claims about cause of death.

title: Frank Olson death and contested interpretation
record_kind: Individual case / archival and family accounts
summary: Olson died after falling from a hotel window; official and family interpretations of the death differ.
outcome_or_limit: Death documented; murder allegations not established by these sources
research_notes: Keep competing accounts separate.

title: George Hunter White New York safehouse
summary: CIA-linked safehouse operations covertly administered LSD to people and observed behavior.
outcome_or_limit: Behavioral observation documented; programmable behavior not proven
research_notes: Names of unwitting individuals generally unavailable.

title: George Hunter White San Francisco safehouse
summary: A CIA-linked safehouse used unwitting subjects in drug and behavior-observation activities.
outcome_or_limit: Testing documented; efficacy not demonstrated
research_notes: Operation Midnight Climax is commonly associated with these activities.

title: Georgetown University Hospital cover arrangement
people_or_groups: Charles Geschickter; CIA Technical Services Staff
summary: Records describe use of a hospital-linked research arrangement and cover for CIA-sponsored chemical or biological research.
outcome_or_limit: Funding/cover documented; particular participant outcomes not established
research_notes: Do not infer every hospital patient was an MKULTRA subject.

title: CIA-funded Allan Memorial Institute work
summary: CIA-funded research intersected with Cameron’s depatterning and psychic-driving treatments at Allan Memorial Institute.
reported_methods: Electroconvulsive therapy; prolonged sleep; repetitive messages
outcome_or_limit: Serious patient harms reported; personality reprogramming efficacy not proven
research_notes: Specific treatment protocols and outcomes varied by patient.

title: Velma Orlikow legal challenge
summary: Former Allan Memorial patient Orlikow pursued legal action; Gottlieb was questioned in related litigation about CIA-supported work.
evidence_status: Documented litigation; experiences require case-level review
outcome_or_limit: Legal testimony exists; no proof of precise mind-control mechanism
research_notes: Separate documented lawsuit from conclusions about alleged behavioral programming.

title: Linda Macdonald first-person account
summary: Macdonald recounts undergoing harmful psychiatric treatment and memory problems at Allan Memorial Institute.
outcome_or_limit: Reported lasting harm; claim-specific independent verification needed
research_notes: Testimony is not a controlled experiment.

title: Nancy Layton interview
summary: Layton describes months of treatment at Allan Memorial in a reported interview.
outcome_or_limit: Reported harm; individual claims require corroboration
research_notes: Interview source documents speaker account, not all claimed mechanisms.

title: Lana Ponting testimony
program: Allan Memorial Institute / disputed MKULTRA links
summary: Ponting gave recorded testimony describing experiences associated with Allan Memorial Institute.
outcome_or_limit: Subject-reported experiences
research_notes: Source is a testimony document; do not elevate every allegation to established fact.

title: MKULTRA record destruction
summary: Most program files were ordered destroyed, restricting reconstruction of the project.
outcome_or_limit: Limits completeness of surviving evidence
research_notes: Absence of records cannot establish a particular unverified claim.

title: 1977 Senate hearings on MKULTRA
summary: The Senate examined surviving subproject records and accounts of unwitting human testing.
outcome_or_limit: Documentary basis for confirmed cases
research_notes: Primary source for scope and limits of established evidence.

title: Sidney Gottlieb testimony on covert experiments
summary: The program leader answered questions about research on unwitting subjects and safehouse activities.
outcome_or_limit: Confirms research and institutional knowledge, not reliable total behavioral control
research_notes: Recollections and institutional statements still require source criticism.

title: Cathy O’Brien MONARCH narrative
summary: Trance Formation of America presents claims of trauma-based programmed control under a purported Project MONARCH.
outcome_or_limit: No independently established MONARCH protocol or control invariant
research_notes: Publication existence verifiable; its government-program claims are not verified by publication.

title: Brice Taylor MONARCH-associated narrative
summary: Thanks for the Memories presents claimed covert conditioning and exploitation narratives later associated with MONARCH discourse.
outcome_or_limit: No independently verified behavioral-control invariant
research_notes: The linked text contains claims; it does not itself independently corroborate them.

title: Academic assessment of MONARCH allegations
summary: A scholarly chapter discusses MONARCH as an alleged offshoot of MKULTRA and evaluates its place in trauma-based mind-control narratives.
evidence_status: Published academic discussion; underlying program unverified
outcome_or_limit: Provides analytical context, not proof MONARCH existed
research_notes: Useful as external assessment of the claim family.

title: MONARCH butterfly symbols and cue narratives
summary: Accounts associate butterfly imagery and cue-triggered alternate states with alleged programming.
outcome_or_limit: No demonstrated reproducible stimulus-response invariant
research_notes: Do not encode motif repetition as independent corroboration.

title: Korean War mind-control concerns vs empirical evidence
summary: Documents show research interest prompted by fears of adversarial brainwashing; later accounts describe limits to evidence for sophisticated enemy drug-hypnosis methods.
evidence_status: Documented historical concern; alleged enemy methods unproven
outcome_or_limit: Fear and program motivation do not establish effectiveness
research_notes: Secondary reporting should be checked against released memos.
